'''Stokasa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] who fought in the arena on the [[Hollow Moon]]. He was able to convince Chewbacca to lead the revolt of the slaves, who, thanks to the timely assistance of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], were able to steal ship and escape the Hollow Moon for the chance of better life.
